title: Chapter 7 Vocabulary
description: Finnish core vocabulary and expressions from the travel, transport, and directions list with context and examples.

questions.question: Timetable
questions.explanation: 'Aikataulu' means a schedule or timetable.

questions.question: Discount
questions.explanation: 'Alennus' means a price reduction or discount.

questions.question: Value
questions.explanation: 'Arvo' means value or worth.

questions.question: Station
questions.explanation: 'Asema' means station (e.g., bus or train station).

questions.question: Automaton / Machine / Dispenser
questions.explanation: 'Automaatti' refers to an automated machine, such as a ticket machine or ATM.

questions.question: Gasoline / Petrol
questions.explanation: 'Bensa' is the colloquial/common word for bensiini (gasoline).

questions.question: Band (musical)
questions.explanation: 'Bändi' means a musical band.
questions.example: Tämä suomalainen bändi on todella hyvä.

questions.question: Affordable / Inexpensive
questions.explanation: 'Edullinen' means affordable, reasonably priced, or inexpensive.
questions.example: Tämä hotelli on siisti ja edullinen.

questions.question: Pensioner / Senior citizen
questions.explanation: 'Eläkeläinen' means a retired person or pensioner.

questions.question: South
questions.explanation: 'Etelä' means the cardinal direction south.

questions.question: To scrub / rub
questions.explanation: Type 4 verb. 'Hangata' means to rub, scrub, or grate.

questions.question: To practice / train
questions.explanation: Type 3 verb. 'Harjoitella' means to practice, drill, or exercise (+ Partitive).
questions.example: Minun täytyy harjoitella suomea joka päivä.

questions.question: Rarely
questions.explanation: 'Harvoin' means rarely or seldom.

questions.question: Easy
questions.explanation: 'Helppo' means easy or simple.
questions.example: Tämä suomen kielen tentti oli helppo.

questions.question: Slow
questions.explanation: 'Hidas' means slow.

questions.question: Wild / Fierce / Tremendous
questions.explanation: 'Hurja' means wild, fierce, furious, or massive.

questions.question: To announce / inform / report
questions.explanation: Type 1 verb. 'Ilmoittaa' means to declare, notify, or advertise.
questions.example: Voitko ilmoittaa minulle, kun juna saapuu?

questions.question: Afternoon
questions.explanation: 'Iltapäivä' refers to the afternoon hours.

questions.question: East
questions.explanation: 'Itä' means the cardinal direction east.

questions.question: River
questions.explanation: 'Joki' (genitive: joen) means river.

questions.question: Santa Claus
questions.explanation: 'Joulupukki' is Santa Claus, famously residing in Finnish Lapland.

questions.question: Gymnastics / Workout session
questions.explanation: 'Jumppa' means a light fitness exercise class or workout session.

questions.question: Train ticket
questions.explanation: 'Junalippu' is a compound word: juna (train) + lippu (ticket).

questions.question: To organize / arrange
questions.explanation: Type 1 verb. 'Järjestää' means to set up, organize, or structure.

questions.question: To get off (a vehicle) / step out
questions.explanation: 'Jäädä pois' means to alight, disembark, or get off a bus/train.

questions.question: Calendar
questions.explanation: 'Kalenteri' means calendar.

questions.question: Map
questions.explanation: 'Kartta' means map.

questions.question: Far away (adverb)
questions.explanation: 'Kauas' is the directional form of far, meaning to a far distance.

questions.question: Season / Period
questions.explanation: 'Kausi' (genitive: kauden) means a season, period, or era.

questions.question: Single ticket / One-way ticket
questions.explanation: 'Kertalippu' means a single-use ticket valid for one journey.

questions.question: In the middle of
questions.explanation: 'Keskellä' is a preposition/postposition meaning in the center or middle of.

questions.question: To interest
questions.explanation: Type 1 verb. Used with partitive object: 'minua kiinnostaa' (it interests me).

questions.question: Conductor (train/bus)
questions.explanation: 'Konduktööri' is the train conductor who checks tickets.

questions.question: Rapids / Torrent
questions.explanation: 'Koski' (genitive: kosken) means rapids or fast-flowing river currents.

questions.question: To travel / go / move along
questions.explanation: Type 1 verb. 'Kulkea' means to travel, move, pass, or walk along.

questions.question: Vehicle / Means of transport
questions.explanation: 'Kulkuneuvo' is a generic term for any vehicle or means of transportation.

questions.question: Ride / Lift
questions.explanation: 'Kyyti' means a ride or lift given in a vehicle.

questions.question: Used / Second-hand
questions.explanation: 'Käytetty' means used or pre-owned.

questions.question: To load / download / charge (battery)
questions.explanation: Type 4 verb. 'Ladata' means to charge a battery, top-up a card, or download/load data.

questions.question: Ship / Large boat
questions.explanation: 'Laiva' means a ship or large seafaring vessel.

questions.question: Airport
questions.explanation: 'Lentokenttä' means airport (literally flight-field).

questions.question: Airplane
questions.explanation: 'Lentokone' means airplane.

questions.question: To fly
questions.explanation: Type 1 verb. 'Lentää' means to fly.

questions.question: Castle
questions.explanation: 'Linna' means a castle or palace.
questions.example: Turun linna on erittäin vanha rakennus.

questions.question: Ticket sales / Ticket office
questions.explanation: 'Lipunmyynti' means the ticket office or ticket sales point.
questions.example: Lipunmyynti on suljettu tähän aikaan illasta.

questions.question: Departure
questions.explanation: 'Lähtö' (genitive: lähdön) means departure.

questions.question: West
questions.explanation: 'Länsi' (genitive: lännen) means the cardinal direction west.

questions.question: Travel card / Transit pass
questions.explanation: 'Matkakortti' is a public transport smartcard/travel card.

questions.question: Suitcase / Travel bag
questions.explanation: 'Matkalaukku' means suitcase or heavy travel luggage.

questions.question: Passenger
questions.explanation: 'Matkustaja' means passenger or traveler.

questions.question: Round-trip ticket / Return ticket
questions.explanation: 'Menopaluu' means a two-way round-trip ticket (literally out-return).

questions.question: Sea / Ocean
questions.explanation: 'Meri' (genitive: meren) means sea or ocean.

questions.question: Hill
questions.explanation: 'Mäki' (genitive: mäen) means a hill.

questions.question: To return
questions.explanation: Type 4 verb. 'Palata' means to return or come back.

questions.question: Return
questions.explanation: 'Paluu' means the noun return.

questions.question: To put / place / set
questions.explanation: Type 3 verb. 'Panna' means to put, place, or insert (synonym: laittaa).

questions.question: Passport
questions.explanation: 'Passi' means passport.
questions.example: Tarvitset passin, kun matkustat Euroopan ulkopuolelle.

questions.question: To fear / be afraid of
questions.explanation: Type 4 verb. 'Pelätä' takes the partitive case (+ Partitive).

questions.question: Arrived / At destination
questions.explanation: 'Perillä' means arrived, at one's destination, or there.

questions.question: North
questions.explanation: 'Pohjoinen' means the cardinal direction north.

questions.question: Park
questions.explanation: 'Puisto' means a public park.

questions.question: To be missing / lack
questions.explanation: Type 1 verb. 'Puuttua' means to be missing or absent.

questions.question: To ask / request
questions.explanation: Type 1 verb. 'Pyytää' means to request, ask for, or invite.

questions.question: Capital city
questions.explanation: 'Pääkaupunki' translates to capital city (pää = head/main + kaupunki = city).

questions.question: To get to / reach / be allowed to
questions.explanation: Type 3 verb. 'Päästä' means to get somewhere, escape, or be permitted access.

questions.question: Track / Railway platform
questions.explanation: 'Raide' (genitive: raiteen) means rail track or train platform.

questions.question: Border
questions.explanation: 'Raja' means a border, limit, or frontier.
questions.example: Suomen ja Ruotsin raja on tuolla.

questions.question: To build
questions.explanation: Type 1 verb. 'Rakentaa' means to construct or build.

questions.question: Beach / Shore
questions.explanation: 'Ranta' (genitive: rannan) means shore, beach, or coast.

questions.question: Dining car (train)
questions.explanation: 'Ravintolavaunu' is the restaurant/dining carriage inside a train.

questions.question: Backpack
questions.explanation: 'Reppu' (genitive: repun) means backpack or rucksack.

questions.question: To arrive
questions.explanation: Type 1 verb. 'Saapua' means to arrive or reach.

questions.question: Dictionary
questions.explanation: 'Sanakirja' means dictionary (literally word-book).

questions.question: Usually / Normally
questions.explanation: 'Tavallisesti' means usually, typically, or normally.

questions.question: Must / Have to
questions.explanation: An impersonal verb indicating necessity. Needs genitive subject: 'minun täytyy' (I must).
